scenarios.prompt: Under load, the source API returns 200 with an empty list and no cursor, long before the real end. The connector treats it as the end, reports success, and finalizes the full run. By morning, thousands of pages are gone from search. Nothing errored. This module is about building connectors that fail loudly instead.
